profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Oracle
profile.summary:
Detail-Oriented IT Professional with more than 12 years of experience in Microsoft Technologies

Specialties: Web Development with Microsoft Technologies like ASP.NET, ADO.NET, WCF, Reporting Services, AJAX, Silverlight, MVC

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer working for the Oracle Hospitality Business Unit. Currently working on the Payment Gateway Solution for the processing of multiple payment options such as Credit Card (EMV, Contactless), Loyalty Cards and 3D Secure payments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and development of the POS ( Point of Sale ) - MyCentral Sync Project. This application allows the customers to synchronize their Point of Sales ( at stores ) with their Online Web ordering sites. Design, development and support of new features for Web ordering sites using Microsoft technologies such as MVC3, WCF, .NET Framework 4 and SQL Server 2008.

positions.title: .NET Developer Specialist
positions.description: My responsibilities include design and development of Advanced Web Applications and Web Portals for multiple ACS Clients in the US as well as IT Internal Projects using the latest Web development technologies such as .NET 4.0, WCF, Ajax, Silverlight. Production Support is also a part of my duties.

positions.title: External Consultant as Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: Assigned by Deintec Consulting to Kansas City Southern of Mexico for the Development of the Rail Road Controlling Web System using ASP.NET, SQL Server 2005 and Sharepoint (Infopath Forms).

company.name: KCSM Kansas City Southern de Mexico

positions.title: External Consultant as Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: Assigned by Deintec Consulting to Yazaki North America for the Development of the Theoretical Inventory Project ( web Dashboard ). The project was created using ASP.NET, Ajax and AS400 DB. Also in charge of the development of new web modules and performance optimization of the internal web portal.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
Worked in several .Net Web projects, the most important were:

TALENT Web Project. Development and implementation of a web based system with purpose of managing and measuring the talent and technical skills of the CFE’s (Mexico’s Electricity Commission) employees. Involved in Design, Development and Implementation phases. 

SIC R-1 Project. Development and implementation of a web based system in order to manage careers of the CFE’s employees. Participated in wide variety aspects of the development, including programming (Development of web forms, code behind and stored procedures), database design, testing and deployment.

SICAHDO Project. Development of the indicators module for the SICAHDO project for the CFE using SQL Data Cubes
